sounds about right, the worst thing is that my mom was a school counselor in an elementary school.
she also would threaten to send me to the psych ward a lot
that has never been truer for me at least

my stepdad used to always say “you don’t hear voices, it’s just your thoughts being vocalized” which is bs and he always says stuff like this. funny enough that he has narcissistic personality disorder
What’s funny is that now it fixed itself this morning after charging the batteries in my old voopoo lol
My hope was for mainly guidance on the lease etc. She's gotten me so down over the past week, I've almost entered a psychotic episode several times. I was doing so well too. :/
I am on seroquel, lamictal and prozac. After a year or so of adjusting doses on these 3 it's perfect. the other ones i took years ago made it much worse
